question: Calculate the total number of wickets taken by each bowler (excluding run-outs and other dismissals not attributed to the bowler), their economy rate (total runs conceded divided by total overs bowled, considering only runs scored off the bat and ignoring any extra runs like wides and no-balls), their strike rate (average number of balls bowled per wicket taken), and their best bowling performance in a single match (the match with the most wickets taken by the bowler, formatted as "wickets-runs" where runs are the runs conceded excluding extras).

WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.ball_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_off_ball
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
bowler_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        COUNT(*) as total_balls,
        SUM(runs_off_ball) as total_runs
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(w.player_out) as total_wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w 
        ON b.match_id = w.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = w.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
        AND w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        SUM(runs_off_ball) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id, innings_no
),
bowler_match_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        b.match_id,
        b.innings_no,
        COUNT(w.player_out) as wickets_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w 
        ON b.match_id = w.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = w.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
        AND w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id, b.innings_no
),
bowler_match_best AS (
    SELECT 
        bwm.bowler,
        bwm.wickets_in_match,
        bmr.runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bwm.bowler ORDER BY bwm.wickets_in_match DESC, bmr.runs_conceded ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_match_wickets bwm
    JOIN bowler_match_runs bmr 
        ON bwm.bowler = bmr.bowler 
        AND bwm.match_id = bmr.match_id 
        AND bwm.innings_no = bmr.innings_no
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT bowler, wickets_in_match, runs_conceded,
        CAST(wickets_in_match AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(CAST(runs_conceded AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) as best_performance
    FROM bowler_match_best
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_bowlers
FROM bowler_wickets bw
JOIN bowler_totals bt ON bw.bowler = bt.bowler
JOIN best_bowling bb ON bw.bowler = bb.bowler
JOIN player p ON bw.bowler = p.player_id
